jobs.text:
About the position

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Engineer with IBM i (AS/400) experience to provide day-to-day application support and enhancements for the client’s environment and related business applications. The role covers platform management, maintenance, and production support for IBM i business applications, as well as new customer onboarding, break-fix work, automation, modernization initiatives, and technical leadership. It requires a strong production-support background, deep expertise in AS/400 technologies, and a commitment to providing excellent service to internal and external stakeholders.

The position develops and supports IBM i applications and business-critical systems, including interfaces such as EDI, flat-file exchanges, SFTP transfers, and database-to-database feeds. The developer works with business analysts and stakeholders to turn requirements into technical solutions for areas including finance, supply chain, and manufacturing. This is a full-time contract role in Plymouth, Wisconsin, with a hybrid work arrangement and an initial contract length of one year or more.

Responsibilities
• Manage the IBM i platform and provide hands-on production support for the environment and business-critical systems.
• Support existing interfaces, including EDI, flat-file exchanges, SFTP transfers, and database-to-database feeds.
• Develop and maintain applications on the IBM iSeries (AS/400), including RPGLE, CLLE, and DB2/SQL.
• Develop and modify reports, DDS display-file screens, queries, and batch processes in response to business requests.
• Monitor and tune scheduled jobs, job queues, subsystems, and print/output queues in coordination with system operations.
• Participate in code reviews, change control, and release management, following SDLC and security practices.
• Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
• Monitor and manage system backups, performance tuning, and replication.
• Support new customer onboarding, break-fix work, automation, modernization initiatives, and technical leadership.

Requirements
• 10 years of hands-on experience developing and supporting applications on IBM i (AS/400).
• Proven experience developing and maintaining enterprise-grade applications.
• Strong proficiency in RPGLE, CLLE, and DB2/SQL for IBM i.
• Production-support experience, including diagnosing job failures, reviewing logs, and resolving data issues under time pressure.
• Working knowledge of IBM i tools and concepts, including ILE, subfiles, journaling, the IFS, job scheduling, and library/object management.
• Experience supporting or building integrations with other systems using flat files, EDI, FTP/SFTP, or APIs.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.
• Ability to work with business users and translate their needs into technical solutions.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

jobs.snippet: Job DescriptionJob DescriptionAbout MJ Celco\nMJ Celco is a family-owned precision metal stamping and sheet metal fabrication company headquartered in Schiller Park, Illinois, with an additional manufacturing facility in
jobs.text:
Job DescriptionJob DescriptionAbout MJ Celco
MJ Celco is a family-owned precision metal stamping and sheet metal fabrication company headquartered in Schiller Park, Illinois, with an additional manufacturing facility in Apodaca, Nuevo León, Mexico. We're IATF 16949-certified and serve customers who depend on us for precision, reliability, and continuous improvement - and we're investing in modernizing the systems that keep our shop floor running.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and motivated IBM i / RPG Developer to join our IT manufacturing systems team in a hybrid capacity. In this role, you will design, develop, maintain, and modernize core applications that power our manufacturing operations-including production scheduling, inventory control, shipping/receiving, and shop floor management.
The ideal candidate bridges traditional RPG development with modern DevOps practices, ideally with experience in Git-based version control and modern development environments like Microsoft Visual Studio Code (using the Code for IBM i extension). Familiarity with modern IBM i build tools such as IBM Bob (TOBi) is a strong plus - we're happy to train the right candidate on our specific toolchain.

Work Schedule & Location (Hybrid)

 Employment Type: Contract, Contract-to-hire,Full-Time
 Schedule: Hybrid (3 days on-site, 2 days remote per week).
 On-Site Location: Schiller Park, Illinois
 Systems Scope: The manufacturing systems this role supports are shared across our Schiller Park, IL and Apodaca, Mexico facilities; all development work is performed from Schiller Park - no relocation or international travel required.
 On-Site Purpose: Collaborative team meetings, direct partnership with executive team and plant/floor management, physical hardware integrations (scanners, scale systems, printers), and critical production deployment support.

Key Responsibilities

 Manufacturing Application Development: Design, code, test, and support applications using RPG IV (RPGLE), Free-Form RPG, and Control Language (CL/CLLE).
 Modern Development Environments: Write and debug code using Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) leveraging the Code for IBM i ecosystem to drive modern development practices.
 DevOps & Build Automation: Set up, configure, and maintain automated build processes using IBM Bob (TOBi) to manage object compilation and dependency tracking across environments.
 ERP Maintenance & Integration: Support, configure, and customize our core manufacturing ERP system.
 Shop Floor & Supply Chain Integration: Develop and maintain integrations for shop floor data collection, barcode scanning, warehouse management systems (WMS), and shipping/logistics platforms.
 Database Management: Write and optimize complex DB2 database queries, triggers, and stored procedures to ensure accurate, real-time tracking of inventory and production metrics.
 System Modernization: Actively migrate legacy codebase - including programs originally written in System/36-era RPG and CL - to Free-Form RPG, and adopt VS Code integrated with Git-based source control.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely (both virtually and in-person during on-site days in Schiller Park) with executive management, plant managers, supply chain teams, and business analysts to translate floor-level requirements into technical solutions.


Qualifications & Skills
Required Technical & DevOps Skills:

 Programming Languages: Proficiency in RPG IV and Free-Form RPG (ILE RPG), and CL/CLLE. Experience modernizing legacy System/36-era RPG and CL programs to current IBM i standards is highly valued - this is a real, ongoing part of our environment, not just a nice-to-have.
 IDE Experience: Proficient in using Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) with the Code for IBM i suite (or Rational Developer for i) for day-to-day development.
 Build & Version Control: Strong experience with Git for version control. Familiarity with modern IBM i build tools (e.g., IBM Bob / TOBi) is a plus - we're happy to train the right candidate on our specific build pipeline.
 Database: Strong experience with DB2 for i and advanced SQL (Embedded SQL, DDL, DML).
 Concepts: Solid understanding of modular programming (service programs, binding directories, modules).


Manufacturing-Specific Qualifications:

 ERP Experience: 4+ years of experience working with manufacturing ERP systems on the IBM i platform.
 Supply Chain Tech: Experience handling EDI standards (e.g., ANSI X12, EDIFACT) for processing purchase orders, shipping notices, and invoices.
 Integration Experience: Familiarity with integrating IBM i with shop floor hardware (e.g., Zebra printers, RF scanners, scale systems).


Soft Skills & Hybrid Requirements:

 High urgency and strong problem-solving skills to minimize manufacturing downtime.
 Self-motivated, collaborative, and highly disciplined to work effectively during remote days.
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical details to non-technical plant staff both in-person and via virtual collaboration tools (e.g., Teams, Slack, Zoom).


Education & Experience

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 5+ years of experience developing in an IBM i (AS/400) environment, preferably within a manufacturing or distribution setting.

About the role

As an AS400 Technical Lead — COBOL & RPG, you will be responsible for end-to-end technical delivery and hands-on development across AS400 environments. You will combine strong technical expertise with delivery leadership and stakeholder management, working closely with cross-functional technical teams, client stakeholders, and subject matter experts across onshore and offshore delivery models.

In this role, you will

• Own end-to-end delivery and hands-on coding across AS400 , COBOL , RPG , and CL environments, ensuring adherence to scope, quality, and timelines.

• Lead and manage cross-functional technical teams, driving productivity, capacity planning, and delivery governance across onshore and offshore models.

• Act as the primary stakeholder interface, working with client SMEs, resolving dependencies, and securing sign-offs on extracted business rules.

• Provide clear executive status reporting to leadership, including progress, risks, financials, and mitigation plans.

What you need to have to be considered

• 9 years of overall IT experience, with strong experience working with AS400 applications .

• Strong hands-on experience with AS400 environments.

• Strong programming experience with RPG and COBOL/400 .

• Experience with CLLE.

• Experience with SQLRPGLE.

• Experience working with DB2/400.

• Experience leading technical delivery and cross-functional technical teams.

• Strong stakeholder and client-facing communication skills.

These will help you stand out

• Knowledge of AS400 Synon.

• Healthcare industry experience, particularly within Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM).

• Experience with CI/CD practices.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a Remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

Salary and Other Compensation

The annual salary for this position is between $83,250 to $130,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits

• Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance

• Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

• 401(k) plan and contributions

• Long-term/Short-term Disability

• Paid Parental Leave

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.text:
About the position

Weaver Popcorn Manufacturing is hiring an IBM i (AS/400) Programmer to develop, maintain, and improve applications used to run the business. This remote opportunity includes time working alongside the current programmer before their planned retirement. During the transition, the new hire will learn how applications support manufacturing and business operations and document that knowledge for future use.

The role uses RPG and SQL to address business needs, improve existing applications, and maintain reliable critical systems. The programmer works directly with end users, business analysts, and IT colleagues to take changes from requirements through development, testing, and support.

Responsibilities include developing RPG programs, scripts, and stored procedures; translating business needs into technical solutions; testing and troubleshooting code; maintaining and optimizing Db2 for i databases; integrating IBM i applications with web services, APIs, and third-party systems; documenting systems and changes; applying application security and access controls; and collaborating with technical and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities
• Design, write, and enhance RPG programs, scripts, and stored procedures on IBM i, implementing clean, efficient, maintainable business rules.
• Gather and document requirements with end users and business analysts, review data structures, workflows, and system dependencies, and recommend changes.
• Unit-test and debug code to verify results, protect data integrity, and maintain performance; investigate defects and system errors, support users, and resolve issues to minimize downtime.
• Create and modify Db2 for i tables, indexes, and relationships; write SQL queries and stored procedures, tune slow queries, and use performance metrics to identify bottlenecks.
• Work with IT and business partners to integrate IBM i applications with web services, APIs, and third-party systems, ensuring data moves accurately and reliably.
• Maintain program specifications, user guides, system diagrams, and records of code changes and configurations; document key applications during the transition.
• Implement application security and access controls in accordance with company policies and applicable data protection requirements.
• Collaborate with programmers, system administrators, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and share best practices; stay current with IBM i tools and development practices.

Requirements
• High school diploma or GED.
• Strong RPG programming skills and experience developing or supporting IBM i (AS/400 or iSeries) applications are listed as preferred qualifications.
• Familiarity with Control Language (CL), Data Description Specifications (DDS), and IBM i architecture, file systems, libraries, and security is preferred.
• Experience with relational databases and SQL programming on IBM i is preferred.
• Familiarity with web services, APIs, and data exchange formats used in system integrations is preferred.
• Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, attention to detail, and the ability to write clean, maintainable code are preferred.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment, collaborate across departments, and manage competing deadlines are preferred.
• Interest in continuing to learn IBM i technologies and development practices is preferred.

Nice-to-haves
• Experience developing or supporting IBM i (AS/400 or iSeries) applications, with strong RPG programming skills.
• Familiarity with Control Language (CL), Data Description Specifications (DDS), and IBM i architecture, file systems, libraries, and security.
• Experience with relational databases and SQL programming on IBM i.
• Familiarity with web services, APIs, and data exchange formats used in system integrations.
• Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, attention to detail, and an ability to write clean, maintainable code.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment, collaborate across departments, and manage competing deadlines.
• Interest in continuing to learn IBM i technologies and development practices.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
